description: Newest 4-day-week and flexible job postings from 4dayweek.io's public RSS feed: role title, company (author field), link, publish time. The feed has no salary or location fields, so they are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_nodesk_remote_jobs when you need newest remote job postings from NoDesk's public RSS feed; jobs_wantedly when you need newest job postings from Wantedly's public projects API. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
